payg.title: Charge by traffic
payg.automatic: Connect freely. Pay as you go.
payg.comboIntro: One plan. More room to explore.
payg.loadFailed: Pay-as-you-go details could not be loaded.
payg.adminHint: Charge by traffic is automatic for all eligible members. Active and paid queued fixed-term plans keep their squads until expiry; future renewals exclude them.

traffic.connectDetail: Enabled traffic billing and sufficient balance automatically open eligible squads. Connecting alone never buys a block.
traffic.firstBlockDetail: At the threshold, a 1 GiB block covers reported traffic. At the example rate, 924 MiB remains and the wallet falls to 9 TXB.
traffic.useCreditDetail: Use prepaid traffic before buying more. This example has 512 MiB left and a 9 TXB wallet; billing occurs by blocks.
traffic.nextBlockDetail: New reported traffic after exhaustion buys another block at its current price. Here, 1.5 GiB used costs 2 TXB, leaving 512 MiB.
traffic.reconnectDetail: Reconnect to the same node and keep unexpired credit. Here, 512 MiB remains and the wallet stays at 8 TXB.
traffic.expireDetail: Unused credit expires 72 hours after the latest block purchase. Without new traffic, expiry buys nothing; this wallet stays at 8 TXB.

hourly.enableDetail: At 1 TXB/hour, a 10 TXB wallet pays only the remaining half-hour. The activation balance requirement is an eligibility check, never a debit or hold.
hourly.renewDetail: Enabled squads renew even while idle. The next UTC hour may be funded shortly before its boundary; insufficient funds stop access when the paid hour ends.
hourly.poolDetail: Traffic inside the shared daily full-speed allowance adds no traffic charge. Each enabled squad still pays its own hourly fee.
hourly.extraDetail: After explicit opt-in, continuing traffic buys full-speed blocks at the approved price: 0.20 TXB here. Insufficient funds means reduced speed.
hourly.disableDetail: Voluntary disable stops this squad immediately, without refund, and starts its configured cooldown. Other hourly squads keep purchased traffic credit until midnight UTC.
hourly.midnightDetail: At 00:00 UTC, daily allowance resets and unused extra credit expires. Disabled squads stay disabled; expired credit is not refunded.
hourly.throttleDetail: After the daily allowance and purchased full-speed credit run out, the configured reduced speed applies. Hourly charges continue while enabled.
